description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in beautiful St. Petersburg, FL, as a dedicated Full-time Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA). This facility, with a capacity of 55-59 beds and a current census of 43, offers a vibrant and supportive environment for both patients and staff. Located conveniently on a main street with ample shopping nearby and a nice residential neighborhood behind the building, you'll also enjoy being just 15 minutes from the beach. The center features two courtyards, providing pleasant outdoor spaces.

In this full-time role, you will play a crucial part in helping patients regain mobility and improve their quality of life through personalized therapy plans. We are seeking a compassionate and skilled PTA eager to contribute to a team-oriented setting.

This is an excellent opportunity to advance your career in a facility that values patient care and employee well-being. We offer a competitive hourly rate of $38.00 - $48.00, reflecting your experience and dedication.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in Florida
Associate's degree from an accredited PTA program
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as a PTA, preferably in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $38.00 - $48.00, based on experience.

description:
